summary: IAMGOLD Corporation filed a Form 6-K furnished with a June 17, 2026 news release announcing an amendment to its senior secured revolving credit facility. The facility was increased from $650M to $850M and extended to June 17, 2030, from December 20, 2028, with an accordion feature of up to $250M. Pricing improved to SOFR plus 1.875%-2.875% margin and the max total net leverage ratio covenant increased to 4.0x. The facility remains undrawn. It is secured by certain assets and subsidiary guarantees. National Bank of Canada is administrative agent; National Bank Capital Markets and RBC Capital Markets are co-lead arrangers. This is a routine financing amendment, not a special situation.
